## Research Papers & Publications

- [SLTE Generative AI & Synthetic Data Research Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#efast-2026-synthetic-data): "Can Synthetic Data Replace Real Data? Evaluating the Efficacy, Limits, and Label Trustworthiness of Generative Data in Supervised Learning" (Accepted at EFAST 2026). Proposes the Synthetic Label Trustworthiness Estimation (SLTE) framework for CTGAN generative data.
- [Social Media Behavioral Economics Research Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#nicsdg-2026-social-media): "The Impact of Social Media Use on Student Productivity: A Behavioral Economics Perspective" (Abstract Accepted at NICSDG-2026).
- [Student Performance Prediction Thesis Paper](https://theniyazkhan.bond/#thesis-student-performance): "Student Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning" (Metropolitan University AI Thesis).

## Software Engineering Projects

- [CampusBite Repository](https://github.com/theniyazkhan): Canteen pre-ordering and queue management platform built with Vue.js, Node.js, and MySQL.
- [HealthBridge Repository](https://github.com/theniyazkhan/HealthBridge): Unified healthcare ecosystem, blood donor geolocation search, and pharmacy inventory system.
- [Parlor Management System Repository](https://github.com/theniyazkhan/parlourmanagementsysyem): Java Swing desktop salon management software with custom dark UI styling.
- [Personal Portfolio Source Code](https://github.com/theniyazkhan): Interactive Vue 3 portfolio featuring scroll-reveal engine, glassmorphism UI, vector kitten companion, and AI assistant query engine.
